calculation.expression: shift(-1, where((equal_weight_benchmark_20d_return < 0) OR (20d_residual_dispersion > trailing_120d_median), -sum_10d(asset_log_return - equal_weight_log_return) / mean_20d(rolling_20d_volatility)))
calculation.description: Contrarian cross-asset residual return, normalized by smoothed volatility and lagged one day; active when either the equal-weight benchmark has a negative 20-day return or cross-asset residual dispersion is above its trailing median.

validation.regime_notes: 10-day IC by regime: 2024-2026 0.16484 (90 dates), 2027-2029 0.01580 (643 dates), 2030-2032 0.03681 (406 dates). 2020-2023 produced no qualifying observations in the runtime-aligned sample. Small 15-asset cross-section implies conservative uncertainty interpretation.
